## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Feb 25, 2026 - Aug 14, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Appleeater69_, Aug 14, 2026, 1/5: "First of all, it is Extremely slow for actual steps to be counted. Sometimes up to an hour. When many others are instantaneous. Second and biggest let down, I had a move streak of 854 days. Went for a run a little late and forgot my phone. (Don’t have the Apple watch) The next day I noticed I was 20 away from my goal. So needless to say my move streak was ended and no way to change it even though I kept it going. STUPID!!!"
            2. _Ueundi1772_, Aug 1, 2026, 1/5: "It keeps miscounting my steps and pausing counting. I walked 36,000 steps and my other walking apps were counting properly. Then suddenly it glitches. It went back to 18,000 and I lost my progress in the other apps due to them getting their information through this app. :/ it continues to glitch it’s not the first time it’s happened. I hope this gets fixed"
            3. _Vronjo_, Jul 31, 2026, 2/5: "I love the workout and trainers. I’ve done a few programs. Lately, the workout pauses in the middle of workout and then crashes 3/4 through. The issue is that I can’t resume where it crashed. I have had to finish the remaining workout without the video."
